row.required_documents: Passport, recent photo, Schengen visa application form, cover letter, travel itinerary, accommodation proof, financial proof, travel insurance
row.entry_requirements: Passport: EU Visa Code: issued within the previous ten years, with at least two blank pages and at least three months of validity after intended departure from Schengen (after the last intended departure for several visits). For an application handled by the Spanish Embassy in New Delhi, its checklist requires at least six months beyond the planned departure date, this is a consular-district filing requirement, not a replacement for the general EU minimum. Follow the checklist of the consular office competent for your residence. Onward travel: Confirmed return or onward travel reservation matching the requested visa validity. Accommodation: Hotel booking(s) for the entire stay, or a notarised Spanish invitation letter ('carta de invitación'). Funds: Original bank statements for the last 3–6 months, ITR/Form 16, salary slips or sponsorship letter, sufficient means are generally assessed around €95–€110 per person per day, often reduced by 50% if accommodation is prepaid, based on the current SMI/IPREM rate. Travel insurance required. Biometrics collected. Health: Schengen travel medical insurance (minimum €30,000 coverage, valid throughout the Schengen area)
row.special_conditions: Children under six are exempt from the visa fee, children aged six to under twelve pay EUR45.. Applicants whose fingerprints were captured for a Schengen visa within the last 59 months may not need to provide biometrics again. Family members of EU/EEA/Swiss nationals may follow a facilitated, fee-exempt procedure with different documents. Diplomatic/official/service passport holders are subject to separate bilateral exemption rules. A valid Schengen visa issued by another member state generally permits short-stay entry to Spain. Processing time (as stated): Normally 15 calendar days from the day after submission; may extend to 45 calendar days if an interview or further documents are required.
row.max_stay_text: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen area
row.processing_text: Normally 15 calendar days from the day after submission; may extend to 45 calendar days if an interview or further documents are required.

application_method.quote: This Consular Office is competent to accept visa applications from third-country nationals residing in the consular district who are travelling to Spain as their only or main destination. Who can apply for a visa: Applications must be submitted in person. If the applicant is a minor, the application must be submitted by their legal representatives. ​Place of submission : Applications must be submitted through any BLS VAC with prior appointment through the following link .

entry_requirements.quote:
The applicant shall present a valid travel document satisfying the following criteria:
(a)
its validity shall extend at least three months after the intended date of departure from the territory of the Member States or, in the case of several visits, after the last intended date of departure from the territory of the Member States. However, in a justified case of emergency, this obligation may be waived;
(b)
it shall contain at least two blank pages;
(c)
it shall have been issued within the previous 10 years.

The passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond the planned departure date from the Schengen territory. It must also contain at least 2 blank pages. Passports issued more than 10 years ago will not be accepted.

This Consular Office is competent to accept visa applications from third-country nationals residing in the consular district who are travelling to Spain as their only or main destination.

special_conditions.quote: The legal period for reaching a decision is of 15 calendar days as of the day after the application submission date, but this period may be extended to 45 calendar days if an interview or additional documents are requested.
